self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Reckless Cinnabar (R1): HP +20%; ATK increased by 0.8% of Max HP. When the wielder's HP is below 50%, the ATK bonus is 1.8% of Max HP instead. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A "firewood staff" that was once used in ancient and long-lost rituals.

refinements.1: HP increased by <r>20%</r>. Additionally, provides an ATK Bonus based on <r>0.8%</r> of the wielder's Max HP. When the wielder's HP is less than 50%, this ATK Bonus is increased by an additional <r>1%</r> of Max HP.
refinements.2: HP increased by <r>25%</r>. Additionally, provides an ATK Bonus based on <r>1%</r> of the wielder's Max HP. When the wielder's HP is less than 50%, this ATK Bonus is increased by an additional <r>1.2%</r> of Max HP.

refinements.4: HP increased by <r>35%</r>. Additionally, provides an ATK Bonus based on <r>1.4%</r> of the wielder's Max HP. When the wielder's HP is less than 50%, this ATK Bonus is increased by an additional <r>1.6%</r> of Max HP.
refinements.5: HP increased by <r>40%</r>. Additionally, provides an ATK Bonus based on <r>1.6%</r> of the wielder's Max HP. When the wielder's HP is less than 50%, this ATK Bonus is increased by an additional <r>1.8%</r> of Max HP.

fr.flavor: Un « bâton de feu » utilisé il y a bien longtemps dans quelque rituel ancien aujourd'hui disparu.

refinements.1: Les PV sont augmentés de <r>20 %</r>. Le personnage équipé de l'arme obtient également un bonus d'ATQ équivalant à <r>0,8 %</r> de ses PV max, et lorsque ses PV sont inférieurs à 50 %, il obtient un bonus d'ATQ supplémentaire équivalant à <r>1 %</r> de ses PV max.
